displayDescription: Dusk-slate mid-century poster: a figure raises a bright idea that draws out into a connected system of nodes.
limitations: Flat procedural illustration. Print grain is a seeded Canvas 2D speckle texture over the artwork only, not scanned paper or real offset printing. Copy sits above the grain for legibility, so the lettering itself is not grain-textured.
No source frames matched in BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json, so the dusk-slate #22313B background was chosen from the subject and mood without source evidence.
No reviewed preview recipes were supplied. The preview shows the base style implementation.
System fonts are used (Georgia; Futura or Avenir with Helvetica/Arial fallback), so glyphs may differ by platform.
Blender was excluded on user instruction.
Rendering and browser QA have not been run by the agent. The host performs them.
